answer: A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, as the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the pulse band is published for each class. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the thread audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 122 to 215 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the whisper identity is graded at all. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
